profile.headline: Software at Google; prev SpaceX
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with strong interests in security, systems development, and aerospace. I pride myself on my ability to pick up new skills quickly and have experience in areas of computing ranging from UI all the way through to hardware, although most of my experience relates to networks and low level systems. While I don't believe in the concept of a true full stack developer, I do believe in being able to adapt to changing roles and requirements quickly, and that is where I excel.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Google Cloud - HPC and Accelerator Networking

I debug high performance networking issues through the stack, with an emphasis on node level, offloaded networking.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a team of seven engineers. Set technical direction with an emphasis on developing my reports' skills and careers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Variety of high impact contributions in network and satellite software through the "startup transition" phase of Starlink, as we moved from private beta to millions of customers.
positions.insights: Embedded Systems, Software Design and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Development and deployment of a proprietary sales assistance tool using Docker, Kubernetes and C# (ASP.NET)

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Management and maintenance of a WISP network and small-scale VoIP system. Provided principal front line and systems level technical skills to this small-town company during two internships.

projects.title: Linux OS compatibility layer
projects.description: Developed Linux system call and process abstraction interface layer for the Nautilus kernel. Allows user programs targeting Linux to work without modification on Nautilus with only a custom linking process. C, x86 assembly, reverse engineering

projects.title: Modernization of systems security course
projects.description: Updated several outdated course materials and project architecture to modern equivalents. GitHub CI, C(++), Python, Linux, Docker
